local_review.finding_body: The coordinate build script hardcoded version 5.1.15 for three Micronaut companion artifacts even though it already derives the tested version as libraryVersion. This violated the version-agnostic test requirement in FS-test-contract.2.5 and Review Signal #4 because the suite would keep those dependencies pinned when reused for a later tested version.
local_review.finding_title: Generated test dependencies pin the requested library version
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the three hardcoded Micronaut companion dependency versions with $libraryVersion so the full Micronaut test stack follows the harness-selected tested version. Forge finalization then completed successfully with no further publishable changes.
local_review.review_comment: Confirmed the diff is limited to one coordinate and its allowed metadata, stats, and test files; only reachability-metadata.json files are present. The tests exercise public WebSocket client/server behavior from a separate package, use bounded timeouts, run under Native Image without skips or tolerated failures, and do not retain the scaffold. The reported dynamic-access result is the valid 0/0 no-calls case. After the repair, Forge finalization passed all three test lanes, metadata routing and validation, generated-test validity, deterministic package updates, style checks, and regenerated library statistics without further publishable changes.
